source_inspiration: TrainHeroic-style 5-day strength and hypertrophy mesocycle (Gorrell BUILT, Lezama 5D, Lemke RIR-wave blocks)

wednesday.name: Lower Body — Posterior Chain / Glutes & Hamstrings

back_squat.name: Back Squat
back_squat.notes: Establish in Week 1 Monday primary. Note if swapped to goblet, hack, or safety-bar squat.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.notes: Monday accessory. Machine load as written on the stack or sled.

leg_curl.name: Seated or Lying Leg Curl
leg_curl.notes: Used Monday (lighter) and Wednesday (main hamstring accessory). Note seated vs lying.

overhead_press.name: Dumbbell or Barbell Overhead Press
overhead_press.notes: Tuesday secondary. Note DB vs barbell, and if DB, load per hand.

incline_db_bench.name: Incline Dumbbell or Machine Press
incline_db_bench.notes: Tuesday accessory. Load per dumbbell if applicable.

overhead_triceps_extension.name: Overhead Triceps Extension or Skull Crusher

romanian_deadlift.name: Romanian Deadlift
romanian_deadlift.notes: Establish in Week 1 Wednesday primary. Note if swapped to trap-bar RDL or deadlift.

step_up_or_reverse_lunge.name: Step-Up or Reverse Lunge
step_up_or_reverse_lunge.notes: Wednesday accessory. Load per side, and which variation.

back_extension.name: 45-Degree Back Extension
back_extension.notes: Wednesday accessory and Friday hinge-balance option. Bodyweight or added load.

barbell_or_chest_supported_row.name: Barbell or Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
barbell_or_chest_supported_row.notes: Establish in Week 1 Thursday primary. Note which variation.

chinup_or_lat_pulldown.name: Weighted Chin-Up, Pull-Up, or Lat Pulldown
chinup_or_lat_pulldown.notes: Thursday secondary. Use BW, BW plus added load, or pulldown stack. Note which variation.

straight_arm_lat_pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Lat Pulldown or Dumbbell Pullover

rear_delt_fly.name: Face Pull or Chest-Supported Rear Delt Fly

front_squat.name: Front Squat or Goblet Squat
front_squat.notes: Establish in Week 1 Friday primary. Note front squat vs goblet or safety-bar swap.

bulgarian_split_squat.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
bulgarian_split_squat.notes: Friday secondary. Load per hand or total, and which hold.

single_leg_rdl.name: Single-Leg RDL or Cable Pull-Through
single_leg_rdl.notes: Friday hinge-balance accessory. Load per side if unilateral.

notes: Working weights start empty. After each session, log actual loads, reps, and RPE, then update the matching working_weights entry. Add a personal_records object when a reported set is a best-to-date for that lift and rep range. Do not invent loads. preferred_start_date is Monday, November 30, 2026 in America/Phoenix so the weekly calendar lines up. Split: Mon quad squat, Tue upper push, Wed posterior hinge, Thu back/pull, Fri full lower and core.
